g.text: INGREDION THAILAND — SPRINT 18K SPRAY DRYER PLANT (KALASIN)
REDUNDANT CISCO CORE SWITCHES & REDUNDANT SERVER INFRASTRUCTURE CONFIGURATION
12-Core OM3/OS2 Fiber Optic Patch Panel (LC Duplex)
OPERATION 1 ROOM — CENTRAL CONTROL & NETWORK CABINET
Role: Primary Layer 3 Gateway & STP Root
Role: Primary FactoryTalk View SE Data & Alarm Server
Role: Secondary FactoryTalk View SE Data & Alarm Server
FT View SE Client / Batch Control
FT View SE Client / Dryer Control
MAIN CONTROL PANEL (MCP-01) — CONTROLLOGIX CS1 - CS4
Slots 03-12: Redesigned Balanced I/O (4 DI / 2 DO / 2 AI / 2 AO)
1. CISCO CORE SWITCH HIGH AVAILABILITY (HSRP v2):
• SW-CORE-01 is configured with Priority 110 (Active Gateway for all VLANs).
• SW-CORE-02 is Standby (Priority 100). Automated failover time < 900 ms.
• FT View SE Primary (SRV-01) & Secondary (SRV-02) have dual cross-connected NICs.
• Private direct Cat6A Heartbeat link on NIC 3 ensures zero split-brain.
• Carries VLAN 30 (Control), VLAN 50 (MCC Drives), and VLAN 99 (Management).
• Connected to SW-MCC-01 Stratix 5700 switch feeding PowerFlex VFDs.
4. FIBER OPTIC BACKBONE TO SERVER ROOM:
• Redundant 10G/1G multi-strand fiber connecting Core Switches to FDF-SR01.
• Ensures continuous access to Historian, Batch Archives, and Active Directory.
